question: How do the original five IL-1 recipient-index components and five fixed downstream-context transcripts differ within the original paired recipient units?
decision: Clarify the measured recipient branches without fitting another predictor or treating ERBB reference work as IL-1 completion.
strongest_rival: Tumor/normal selection, reference-label uncertainty, RNA composition and nonspecific inflammatory input can create receptor/feedback RNA patterns without IL-1-specific recipient competence.
discriminator: All ten per-gene paired log-CPM differences, exact original five signed index contributions, full-library primitives, and explicit overlap of two added targets with the old response.
exposure_record: Original pilot predictions, unfavorable fibroblast result, source attribution and ERBB reference are exposed. Exact ten feature names and original primary24-row roster were inspected before this freeze; new per-gene counts and differences were not inspected. Source-role map reviewed prospectively.
biological_unit: Twelve original patients, each contributing normal and LUAD recipient pseudobulk units for AT2 and alveolar fibroblast candidate labels.
nesting_and_overlap: Twenty-four patient/recipient pairs reuse the same twelve patients, not twenty-four donors; both recipients and histologies are nested within patient. Counts pool repeated original libraries.
population_and_selection: Exactly original A12_model_inputs rows at uncertainty0.2 and cell_floor50; twelve pairs per recipient and48 distinct recipient units. No new annotations or cohort/floor sensitivity.
contrast: Within-patient LUAD-minus-normal, separately for each of the two original candidate recipient labels.
endpoint: Per-gene log2(1+CPM) from summed unit counts/full-feature library totals; weighted original-index contributions and individual downstream-context differences.
methods: Stream the original hash-matched processed unit-count matrix, verify all48 full-library sums, save480 count/log/weight primitives and240 paired rows, and reconstruct all24 original index values within1e-10. Independent scalar log2 checks; equal-patient means only.
missingness_and_exclusions: Any changed roster/support, absent/duplicate feature/unit, invalid count/library or original-index parity failure stops. Preserve label uncertainty, all signs and old unfavorable fibroblast prediction.
multiplicity: Ten fixed genes by two recipient labels; all20 summaries and all patient rows retained. No test, ranking, refit, correlation with overlapping response or new signed downstream score.
precision_basis: Exposed fixed-component description; no new inferential test, effect margin or power claim. Twelve paired patients supply descriptive units.
interpretation_limit: NFKBIA/TNFAIP3 overlap the old response; their agreement is not independent evidence. Feedback-associated RNA is not effective inhibition. No IL-1-specific activation, receptor engagement, protein function or causal competence inference.
stop_rule: Stop for hash/feature/roster/full-library/count/index conflict; no relabeling, denominator substitution or floor relaxation.
amendment_reason: New component-resolved exposed description of the original IL-1 pilot; original model and ERBB results remain unchanged.
